Designed with user convenience in mind, our app brings language barriers to a minimum, ensuring that you can express yourself effortlessly in any corner of the globe.

Key Features:

Effortless Translation:

Easily input the text you want to translate in the first tab, where a dedicated screen allows you to express yourself in any language you desire.

Interactive Interface:

Navigate through a user-friendly interface that simplifies the translation process. Tap the input box, and a new screen awaits for you to input the text you wish to translate.

Recent Translations:

The second tab showcases a list of your recently translated texts, providing quick access to your most-used phrases.

Text-to-Speech Functionality:

Enhance your language learning experience by utilizing the native iOS text-to-speech feature. Have translated text spoken aloud with a simple tap. Note: Text-to-speech is not supported for Latvian, Slovenian, Lithuanian, and Estonian languages.

Copy and Share:

Seamlessly copy translated text to use in other applications or share it with friends and colleagues.

Local Storage with Core Data:

Your recently translated texts are securely stored on your device using Core Data, ensuring accessibility even when offline.

Why Choose Translator App?

Intuitive Design: Our app is crafted with an intuitive design, making language translation a breeze for both beginners and seasoned users.

Privacy Matters: Rest assured, your translations are stored locally on your device, respecting your privacy.

Broad Language Support: Translator App supports a wide array of languages, allowing you to communicate effectively across borders.

Download Translator App now and break down language barriers effortlessly. Experience the power of seamless translation at your fingertips!
